description:
The whole pipeline in one call: trace the image to a clean SVG, then render that SVG into the icon collections asked for. This is the tool to use on an AI-generated icon. Presets:
  pwa        public/ — favicon PNGs + favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon, 192/512 PWA icons, maskable pair, manifest.webmanifest and a <head> snippet.
  favicon    public/ — the 16/32/48 PNGs, a real multi-size favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon and the <head> snippet.
  web        public/ — the full catalogue: every favicon, apple, Android, maskable and Windows tile size the app offers.
  tauri      src-tauri/icons — the exact set `tauri icon` generates: PNGs, icon.ico, icon.icns and the Windows Store logos.
  electron   build/ — icon.icns (mac), icon.ico (win) and build/icons/*.png (linux), the layout electron-builder picks up by default.
  android    res/mipmap-* — ic_launcher, ic_launcher_round and the adaptive ic_launcher_foreground at every density, plus the v26 XML and the 512 Play listing icon.
  ios        AppIcon.appiconset — every iPhone/iPad size plus the 1024 marketing icon, with Contents.json. Forced opaque: iOS rejects alpha.
  extension  icons/icon-16..128.png for a Chrome/Firefox MV3 extension, with the manifest fragment to paste in.

appName.description: Name used in the webmanifest and the logolab-icons.md notes.

appearance.description: How the logo sits in the icon. Default: full-bleed, transparent; the icons that must be opaque take `opaque`.

background.description: Card colour behind the logo, or "transparent" (the default — the source art is used full-bleed).

invert.description: Invert the logo colours (a dark mark for a light context).

opaque.description: The icons a platform will not take transparent: apple-touch (iOS draws alpha as black), the maskable pair, the iOS set, the Play icon and the Android adaptive foreground. Favicons and the "any" PWA icons keep `background`. Without a colour here or in `background`, one is picked from the logo and reported.

background.description: Fill colour of the opaque icons, e.g. your brand background.

paddingPct.description: Safe-zone inset of the opaque icons, as % of size. Default: paddingPct.
Safe-zone inset as % of size. Default 0. Maskable targets raise this to their own floor.

radiusPct.description: Corner radius as % of size, for shape=rounded. Default 24.

scale.description: Logo scale inside the safe box. Default 1.

tintColor.description: Recolour a monochrome logo through its alpha, e.g. "#5b5bd6".

backgroundColor.description: background_color (splash screen) in the manifest. Default: the opaque icons’ fill.

despeckle.description: 0 keeps every speck, 100 is aggressive. Default 25.

detail.description: high lifts the flat-art raster cap 2048 → 4096: crisper, ~4x the work.

fidelity.description: Shape-beautification tolerance in px; 0 disables snapping to circles/lines.

flattenOnto.description: Composite a TRANSPARENT source onto this colour before tracing, e.g. "#ffffff". Omit to keep the alpha. (Not the card colour — that is appearance.background.)

gradients.description: auto (default) probes for real colour ramps. flat forces solid fills (right for most icons). rich forces gradient fitting.

image.description: Path to the generated or drawn icon image.

keepSvg.description: Also write the traced SVG here (a copy is placed inside the collection anyway).

layering.description: Colour mode. stacked (default): a shape paints under the shapes in front of it — fewer nodes, no hairline seams between colours, shapes stay whole in a design tool. tiled: shapes fit edge to edge, with a hole wherever another sits inside. Same edges either way; mono ignores it.

mode.description: auto (default) counts the inks: one ink on paper traces mono, which is far cleaner for line art; anything else traces colour.

outDir.description: Directory to write the icon set into.

removeBackground.description: Drop the detected background layer so the SVG comes back transparent.

smoothing.description: 0 = crisp and node-dense, 100 = smooth and sparse. Default 50.

startUrl.description: start_url in the manifest; the scope is its directory. Default "/".

strokes.description: Trace LINE ART as centreline strokes with a measured stroke-width (open and closed stroked paths you can re-weight), instead of filled outlines of each line. Ink no stroke explains (a dot, a note head) still becomes a fill. In colour mode each stroke is painted in the ink it runs through. Default off.

strokesOnly.description: With `strokes`: NO filled paths at all — the ink no stroke explains (a dot, a note head, a solid shape) is drawn as round-capped strokes too, along its own middle and as wide as it is there; a dot is a round-capped point. Nothing is dropped, but a shape that is not a line is approximated (a square comes back with round ends). For plotters and stroke-only icon sets. Default off.

themeColor.description: theme_color in the manifest and <meta name="theme-color">. Default: backgroundColor.

name: make_app_icons
title: Image → traced SVG → icon set
